import os,glob,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
inp=G['Demo pair 1 input']; out=G['Demo pair 1 output']
print(sorted(G))
# blocks between full separator rows/cols of the separator color (9)
import numpy as np
a=np.array(inp)
sep=9
srows=[i for i in range(a.shape[0]) if (a[i]==sep).all()]
scols=[j for i2 in range(1) for j in range(a.shape[1]) if (a[:,j]==sep).all()]
print(srows,scols)
def blocks(a,srows,scols):
    rb=[0]+[r+1 for r in srows]+[a.shape[0]]
    cb=[0]+[c+1 for c in scols]+[a.shape[1]]
    return [a[rb[i]:rb[i+1],cb[j]:cb[j+1]] for i in range(len(rb)-1) for j in range(len(cb)-1)]
bl=blocks(a,srows,scols)
for b in bl:
    vals,cnt=np.unique(b,return_counts=True)
    print(dict(zip(vals.tolist(),cnt.tolist())))
print(np.array(out))
